userText:
Building: Coit Tower, San Francisco (monument tower).
The front (−z) is the parking circle side.
Footprint: 21.9 m along x by 22.2 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-5.9,8.5],[-8.9,8.5],[-8.9,5.8],[-9.8,5.8],[-11,3],[-10.9,-2.9],[-9.8,-5.7],[-8.9,-5.7],[-8.9,-8.6],[-5.9,-8.6],[-5.6,-10],[-1.7,-11.1],[2.6,-10.9],[5.3,-10],[5.4,-8.6],[8.6,-8.6],[8.6,-5.7],[10,-5.7],[10.9,-1.6],[11,2.6],[10,5.8],[8.6,5.8],[8.6,8.5],[5.4,8.5],[5.4,11.1],[-5.9,11.1]]
Height: the highest point is 64 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. whole fluted concrete tower on its hilltop with trees below, clear sky
  2. tower rising behind the Telegraph Hill apartment building, showing the full shaft and the arcaded crown, flag on top
  3. high oblique aerial of the tower and the circular drive and park on Telegraph Hill

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: Coit Tower is a round, fluted concrete monument about 64 m tall on a wooded hilltop. A plain shaft carries a crown of arched openings near the top, with a flat cap. A round raised terrace under it sits in the park, and the footprint suggests a base of about 21 m across.

final.notes: Coit Tower is a round, fluted concrete monument about 64 m tall on a wooded hilltop. A plain shaft carries a crown of arched openings near the top, with a flat cap. A round raised terrace under it sits in the park, and the footprint suggests a base of about 21 m across.

photos: photo 1: the whole fluted concrete tower on its wooded hilltop, seen from the north-east, with a plain shaft and a crown of arched openings near the top.
photo 2: the tower rising behind the Telegraph Hill apartment building, showing the full shaft and the arcaded crown, with a flag on the roof of the building in front.
photo 3: high oblique aerial view of the round tower on its hill, with the circular drive and park at its foot to the south-east.

components.name: fluted tower shaft
components.why: photos 1 and 2: a plain round concrete shaft with a crown of arched openings; the tower is the signature feature, about 64 m tall

components.name: hilltop terrace
components.why: photo 3: the tower stands on a round raised terrace in the park, which the footprint outlines
